intent.question: Какие параметры AD требуют проверки в выбранных доменах?
intent.action: Review parameter evidence and the stated condition before an administrative decision.
intent.scope: Server-authorized domains; latest domain, controller, replication, DNS, policy and trust observations.
intent.exclusions: No organization compliance verdict without an accepted policy; no inferred client GPO application.
sources: Canonical: AD Context sectional snapshots and collector diagnostics within granted domains.
Supplemental: published deterministic findings and current AD SPN observations.
intent.freshness_expectation: Последнее подтверждённое наблюдение разделов AD; неизвестная свежесть сохраняется.
intent.rights: ad.state view grant; server-resolved domain scope; export requires its own action grant.
intent.coverage: Observed AD sections compared with the expected sections per authorized domain.
intent.completeness: Source-confirmed object/parameter pairs divided by expected pairs in the authorized scope; passed conditions are not the numerator. Unknown when expected population is unconfirmed.
intent.denominator: Ожидаемые разделы и объекты AD в разрешённых доменах; при неизвестном составе процент не вычисляется.
intent.retention: Permanent derived AD facts follow the storage policy; exact snapshot evidence is available only while retained.
intent.provenance: Domain, object, source section, observation timestamp, condition and authority in the control ledger.
intent.deterministic_policy: Retain report_rule_v1 and collector diagnostics separately; passed, failed, not_evaluated and policy_not_defined are distinct.
intent.result_limits: Control rows, history and findings have separate bounds and source timestamps; report rules are not organization compliance.
intent.fallback: Missing control values remain not_evaluated; absent organization policy remains policy_not_defined; partial snapshots cannot pass controls.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: Infrastructure parameters and stated conditions support manual AD review.
acceptance_lanes.authorization: ad.state grant and authorized domain/field scope constrain controls, findings and history.
acceptance_lanes.deterministic_interpretation: Identical control inputs retain report_rule_v1 qualification; undefined policy never becomes passed.
acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Control rows and supplemental collections preserve conditions, actual values and authority.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: Missing values, partial snapshots, stale observations and unavailable history remain explicit.
acceptance_lanes.evidence_audit: Each control retains source observation, rule authority and exact evidence context.

qualification.definition: Existing report_rule_v1 control conditions and collector diagnostics; organization policy may remain undefined.

intent.question: Какие входы на выбранные компьютеры наблюдались за период?

intent.scope: One server-resolved granted domain, selected computers and bounded observation window.
intent.exclusions: Logons are not work duration; DC 4624 alone does not prove workstation interactive use.
sources: Canonical: successful computer-logon observations in the granted domain and window.
Supplemental: latest AD computer inventory for the same domain.
intent.freshness_expectation: Свежесть наблюдений входов и снимка инвентаря проверяется раздельно.
intent.rights: ad.computer-logons view grant with computer_logon_observation; engine enforces domain and event scope; export separately granted.
intent.coverage: Inventory coverage and logon observation coverage are separate source dimensions.
intent.completeness: Duration of source-confirmed logon collection intervals divided by expected source-window duration; neither row count nor an empty result proves continuity. Currently not_proven without source evidence.

intent.provenance: Computer entity, account identity, source event ID, domain and observation time.
intent.deterministic_policy: Present retained 4624/4634 observations against current AD inventory; logons do not establish work duration.
intent.result_limits: Server-resolved report domain and declared period/page bounds apply; inventory and observation coverage are independent.
intent.fallback: Keep empty_unverified, not_collected and partial observation coverage; inventory or observation reader failure is unavailable.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: Observed logons answer the selected computer/window question without estimating work duration.

acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Computer pages and observation detail preserve reader states, cursors and UTC window.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: Empty_unverified, partial, not_collected and unavailable observations remain honest states.

intent.question: Какие пары пользователь — компьютер впервые наблюдались за период относительно базового окна?
intent.action: Inspect newly observed pairs and their exact logon evidence against the preceding baseline.
intent.scope: One server-resolved granted domain, selected users and computers, bounded period and preceding baseline window.
intent.exclusions: Observed novelty is not first-ever use or a risk verdict; missing baseline or identity context leaves novelty undetermined.
sources: Canonical: published permanent Security 4624 history for domain controllers in the granted domain and both windows.
Supplemental: current AD computer inventory, domain controller membership and service-account classification.
intent.freshness_expectation: Свежесть истории входов, базового окна и текущего AD-контекста проверяется раздельно.
intent.rights: ad.computer-logons view grant with computer_logon_observation; server resolves the domain scope before reading history; export is unavailable.
intent.coverage: History bounds, baseline availability, truncation and current AD identity context are separate dimensions; baseline_covered does not prove collection continuity.
intent.completeness: Source-confirmed collection intervals divided by expected source-window duration across both windows; history bounds and pair counts do not prove continuity. Currently not_proven.
intent.denominator: Ожидаемые источники входов выбранного домена × выбранный период и базовое окно; границы истории не доказывают непрерывность сбора.
intent.retention: Published derived history follows the storage policy; exact source events may expire independently.
intent.provenance: User SID, computer GUID, domain, DC source, first observed time and source event ID.
intent.deterministic_policy: Compare first observed user/computer pairs with the retained baseline; novelty requires covered baseline and complete identity context.
intent.result_limits: Baseline days and current period are bounded by MAX_DAYS; history read caps and fact validation may invalidate novelty.
intent.fallback: Uncovered baseline, truncated history, incomplete facts or AD identity suppress confirmed novelty and expose limitations.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: First-observed pairs answer the baseline comparison question.

acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Sealed cursor preserves baseline, current window and first_seen/id order.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: No baseline, truncated history and incomplete identities do not claim a new pair.

intent.question: Какие каналы уведомлений зарегистрированы и настроены?
intent.action: Inspect channel metadata and use the admin metadata API to change it.
intent.scope: Two installation-wide channels: SMTP and Telegram.
intent.exclusions: No credential access, secret availability checks, recipients or delivery in N01.
sources: Canonical: PostgreSQL notification_channels metadata registry.
intent.freshness_expectation: Текущие метаданные и сохранённая ревизия; актуальность доставки не подтверждается.
intent.rights: Admin role, global access.manage and global notifications.channels grant with technical fields.
intent.coverage: Exactly two registered channel kinds.
intent.completeness: Registry completeness only; transport and secret availability are not proven.
intent.denominator: Два канала; not_configured не означает приём сообщения провайдером.
intent.retention: Current configuration is retained; safe changes enter the existing access audit.
intent.provenance: Channel kind, revision and metadata update timestamp.
intent.deterministic_policy: Both channels remain not_configured in N01.
intent.result_limits: Two metadata rows, no export or detail endpoint.
intent.fallback: Read failure is an error, access failure is denied; neither becomes an empty registry.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: Both channel rows show not_configured.

acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Only allowlisted metadata fields leave the repository.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: Standard v2 table; error and denied remain explicit.
acceptance_lanes.evidence_audit: Metadata revision and safe audit are committed atomically.

title: Журнал уведомлений
description: Тестовые задания и выпуски отчётов. dry_run — без отправки; accepted — приём SMTP или Telegram, не подтверждение прочтения.

intent.question: Как завершилась доставка проблемы или выпуска отчёта?
intent.action: Inspect durable jobs; manage approved subscriptions through the administrative API.
intent.scope: Installation-wide notification jobs and report releases, visible only to globally authorized administrators.
intent.exclusions: No message bodies, addresses, credentials, semantic publication or proof of inbox receipt.
sources: Canonical: PostgreSQL notification_outbox, notification_attempts and report_schedule_runs.
intent.freshness_expectation: Сохранённое состояние последней попытки; обработчик запускается отдельным процессом.
intent.rights: Admin role, global access.manage and global notifications.deliveries grant with technical fields.
intent.coverage: Durable test jobs and report releases, simulated attempts and opt-in SMTP/Telegram acceptance.
intent.completeness: dry_run sends nothing; accepted means provider acceptance, not reading by a person.
intent.denominator: Одна строка на проблему или выпуск отчёта, получателя и канал; повторы сохраняют ID задания.
intent.retention: Pending jobs persist until terminal result; no deletion or retention worker is enabled by N03.
intent.provenance: Stable job and subscription IDs, attempt count and safe result code.
intent.deterministic_policy: A fake transport finishes as dry_run; Provider acceptance is recorded per job/channel. Replay reuses the job.
intent.result_limits: At most 200 metadata rows per page; no export or detail endpoint.
intent.fallback: Read failure is an error, access failure is denied; neither becomes an empty registry.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: One problem or report slot yields one job per approved recipient/channel; provider acceptance is explicit.
acceptance_lanes.authorization: Global admin journal grant; current owner and recipient report access rechecked before each attempt.
acceptance_lanes.deterministic_interpretation: dry_run is simulated; accepted never claims inbox receipt. Uncertain provider outcomes require inspection.
acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Allowlisted metadata only, bounded cursor pagination.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: Pending, blocked, retry, failed, cancelled, dry_run, accepted and delivery_unknown are distinct.
acceptance_lanes.evidence_audit: Stable job identity, fenced leases and safe immutable attempt rows.

title: Качество правил
description: Качество опубликованных семантических правил по находкам, решениям аналитиков и сохранённым доказательствам.

intent.user_role: Security analyst and semantic rule reviewer
intent.question: Каково качество опубликованных семантических правил по сохранённым находкам выбранного периода?
intent.action: Inspect per-rule classifications and evidence, then drill into the exact finding cohort for review.
intent.scope: Server-resolved granted domains and findings created within the selected period, bounded to 90 days and 10,000 findings.
intent.exclusions: No source-completeness proof, policy-version attribution or automatic rule changes; unclassified findings have no false-positive estimate.
sources: Canonical: published semantic findings, retained lifecycle decisions before the period end and linked retained facts.
Supplemental: current suppression, repeat observations, evidence availability and policy admission context.
intent.freshness_expectation: Решения учитываются до конца периода; подавление, повторы, evidence и допуск policy отражают текущий снимок и проверяются отдельно.
intent.rights: security.queue view grant with security fields and semantic.review capability; server resolves domain scope before reading; export is unavailable.
intent.coverage: Retained creation cohort and decision history; truncation and missing history are separate limitations, and collection completeness is not proven.
intent.completeness: Source-confirmed retained findings divided by the expected finding population for the granted scope and window; the expected population is unknown. Currently not_proven.
intent.denominator: Для доли FP — FP + confirmed в когорте созданных за период находок; для полноты — ожидаемые находки разрешённого среза, число которых неизвестно.
intent.retention: Findings, lifecycle history and derived evidence follow their storage policies; full source text may expire independently.
intent.provenance: Rule code, exact creation window, retained finding and decision history, and links to retained source facts.
intent.deterministic_policy: FP rate is FP / (FP + confirmed) from each finding's latest classification before period end; accepted risk is excluded.
intent.result_limits: Creation cohort is at most 90 days and 10,000 findings; current policy context does not attribute a finding to a policy version.
intent.fallback: No classified findings means no FP estimate; truncation or missing history stays partial, reader failure stays unavailable.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: Per-rule measurements answer the retained-cohort quality question.
acceptance_lanes.authorization: security.queue grant, security fields, semantic.review and server domain scope are mandatory; export is absent.
acceptance_lanes.deterministic_interpretation: FP denominator, latest classification and exclusion of accepted risk are checked independently.
acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Sealed cohort cursors preserve the window and bounded per-rule metrics.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: Unknown estimates, unsupported accepted risk and partial history are visible without zero substitution.
acceptance_lanes.evidence_audit: Rule code and cohort link back to retained findings, decision history and evidence.

qualification.reason: No automatic control qualification is asserted by this report.

risk.reason: No new risk score or organization risk policy is asserted by this report.

intent.question: Какие действия безопасности наблюдались в выбранном срезе?
intent.action: Review exact observations and deterministic chains before an investigation decision.
intent.scope: Granted DC Security event sources and retained current semantic facts in the selected bounded window.
intent.exclusions: No inferred misuse, missing actions, AI authority or complete source coverage from an empty result.
sources: Canonical: source-native DC Security events and retained current semantic action facts.
Supplemental: deterministic chains, account state and policy evidence within the same granted scope.
intent.freshness_expectation: Подтверждение каждого источника в выбранном окне; факты текущей семантики не восстанавливают пропуски.
intent.rights: security.events.chains view grant with security, technical and raw_evidence; engine-enforced source domain scope; export separately granted.
intent.coverage: Authorized source/category intervals for the selected event window, separate from semantic applicability.
intent.completeness: Source-confirmed Security category intervals divided by expected source-category-window duration, with current-semantic truncation reported separately. Unknown without confirmed continuity.
intent.denominator: Ожидаемые источники Security и категории событий × период; без подтверждения непрерывности процент неизвестен.
intent.retention: Derived action history follows the storage policy; exact raw events/XML may expire and cannot be fabricated.

intent.deterministic_policy: Current semantic action facts and source-native events build deterministic chains within the same granted scope.
intent.result_limits: Bounded event window and pages; current-semantic truncation is separate from source/category continuity.
